description: Returns one directory listing in full: its id, name, endpoint_url, category, link_type, current_sla_score, any verified USDC rank stake, and a summary of its signed check history (number of checks, pass rate, latest check with latency). Use it after discover_monitored_apis to judge a candidate, or to find the listing id that create_escrow_job needs. Free and read-only; it does not probe the endpoint (use check_endpoint for a live check). Give either id or endpointUrl.

endpointUrl.description: The listing's exact endpoint_url, e.g. "https://api.openai.com". Used when id is omitted.

name: get_api_details
title: Get one listing's details
